quarterly_data.quarter: Huatian Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results (half-year report): revenue RMB 10,510,627,614.20, up 35.09% YoY, mainly from higher packaging volume; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 813,402,689.67, up 259.15%; net profit after non-recurring items RMB 250,268,388.02 (RMB -8,131,452.60 a year earlier). Q2 revenue was RMB 57.11 hundred million, RMB 9.12 hundred million more than Q1 and a record quarter; Q2 net profit attributable was RMB 7.27 hundred million, RMB 6.40 hundred million more than Q1.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue RMB 10,510,627,614.20 (+35.09%); net profit RMB 813,402,689.67 (+259.15%); Q2 revenue RMB 57.11 hundred million (record)

quarterly_data.quarter: Huatian Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue mix: integrated circuits RMB 10,510,568,360.78 (100.00% of revenue, up 35.13%) at a 14.35% gross margin (change vs H1 2025 printed as 3.46%). Domestic sales RMB 6,703,742,296.61 (63.78%, up 37.42%, gross margin 14.83%); overseas sales RMB 3,806,885,317.59 (36.22%, up 31.19%, gross margin 13.49%).
quarterly_data.figure: IC gross margin 14.35%; domestic sales +37.42%, overseas +31.19%

quarterly_data.quarter: Huatian Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 operations (half-year report): orders and results grew steadily as packaging-and-test demand rose; automotive-electronics and memory packaging grew further in scale; the company is steadily expanding capacity in line with market demand to prepare for further incremental orders. It started the Huatian Nanjing IC advanced packaging and test industrial base phase-2 stage-2 project (announced 05-23-2026; RMB 652,984.60 invested by mid-year, 0.02% progress, under construction). Construction in progress rose to RMB 4,119,068,318.89 (from RMB 3,423,885,500.04 at 2025 year-end), mainly from infrastructure and equipment awaiting installation (RMB 2,789,168,033.50).
quarterly_data.figure: CIP RMB 4,119,068,318.89; equipment awaiting installation RMB 2,789,168,033.50

quarterly_data.quarter: Huatian Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Major construction-in-progress projects at mid-2026 (half-year report): Huatian Nanjing production area budget RMB 677,637,304.13, 91% complete; Huatian Shanghai new plant budget RMB 800,000,000.00, 94%; Huatian Jiangsu production area budget RMB 864,312,778.23, 88%; Huatian Technology production area budget RMB 562,070,000.00, 76%; Pangu Semiconductor production area budget RMB 415,902,596.14, 66%.
quarterly_data.figure: Shanghai new plant 94% of RMB 800,000,000.00 budget; Nanjing production area 91%

quarterly_data.quarter: Huatian Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 technology (half-year report): the company is focused on scaling volume production on its 2.5D technology platform and on customer development in memory, large-size FCBGA, SiP and automotive electronics; it completed development of 2.5D SiCS, memory vertical wire bonding and FCQFN automotive wettable-flank processes. R&D investment RMB 643,794,661.86, up 32.37%; 30 patents granted in H1, 21 of them invention patents.

quarterly_data.quarter: Huatian Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Main subsidiaries in H1 2026 (half-year report): Huatian Nanjing revenue RMB 2,603,450,023.74 (net profit RMB 85,133,460.06), with orders up sharply YoY; Huatian Xi'an revenue RMB 2,167,334,968.74 (net profit RMB 167,552,114.05); Unisem (Malaysia) revenue RMB 1,816,777,144.95 with a net loss of RMB 5,970,060.90, which the company attributes mainly to exchange-rate moves and higher operating expenses; Huatian Kunshan revenue RMB 1,164,751,155.22.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue and net profit of the four main subsidiaries (amounts in the signal, from the subsidiary table)

quarterly_data.quarter: Huatian Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Acquisition of Huayi Microelectronics (half-year report): as of the report date the acquisition had been approved by the Shenzhen Stock Exchange M&A and restructuring review committee and still needs CSRC registration; the company says it extends Huatian into power-device R&D, design and own-brand business and broadens its packaging-and-test footprint.
